scope: Bounded local P1 item 3: fixture-only serialized stop/permit claim and typed case/review/resume/archive contract

commands.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/contracts tests/unit tests/integration tests/e2e tests/evals -m 'not live' -q -rs --junitxml=artifacts/v4-p0/governance-regression.xml

requirement_coverage.R09: Pre-admission review resumes the same intent without an earlier cycle; cycle retry resumes the original operation/context, while reconciliation and rework remain held.
requirement_coverage.R13: Fixture permit and review commands recheck current subject/program authority, frozen context and current baseline; revoked identity and changed stop revision block a new claim.
requirement_coverage.R15: Typed fixture review response binds immutable case revision, context, operation, artifact, account, purpose and expiry; general policy evaluation remains a later RG1 obligation.
requirement_coverage.R17: PostgreSQL stop/claim races, one true dispatch authority across duplicate workers, bounded expiry and exact historical receipts are tested; no adapter executes.
requirement_coverage.R18: Workspace/goal stop and database outage deny new fixture claims. Automatic schedule cancellation and separately scoped remote read reconciliation are not implemented.
requirement_coverage.R30: A V3 claim moves all child reservations to pending-actual liability in the same transaction; an injected crash rolls back claim and ledger together.
requirement_coverage.R31: Cancellation and unknown reporting retain V3 child liability until a late evidenced settlement; no live charge or provider proof is asserted.
requirement_coverage.R32: Bounded owner/deadline/failure-class cases type retry, reconciliation, rework, review, suspension, terminal and resolved without opening a replacement cycle.
requirement_coverage.R33: Exact resume receipts, case CAS, original context/operation, current stop/authority/baseline and atomic recovery outbox survive an injected pre-commit failure.
requirement_coverage.R34: Fixture owner review rejects stale or mismatched binding; notifications, acknowledgment and deadline escalation deduplicate. Automatic durable timers remain queue item 6.
requirement_coverage.R35: Archive requires committed terminal disposition, reason, nonempty evidence and future retention, and cannot mutate earlier review/permit history.
requirement_coverage.R53: Migration 0026 uses immutable history, scoped insert checks, legal projection transitions, deferred audit checks, empty downgrade/re-upgrade and populated-history rollback refusal.

additional_verification.review: Local self-review repaired trigger field access, permit deadline parsing, case binding and audit gaps, V3 claim/liability atomicity, historical idempotency, policy-denial retry bypass and cross-subject permit replay. A superseded full run exposed the one-second stale-slot test setup race; the future-slot fixture and final suites pass. Independent PR review is NOT RUN.
